svg.aria-label: Project layout: an Aspire AppHost in C#, a Python API with FastAPI, Strawberry GraphQL and Microsoft Agent Framework, and a React web app with Fluent UI and the design kit.
svg.text: PROJECT LAYOUT · ONE ASPIRE APPHOST · A PYTHON API · A REACT WEB APP
